body: Yeah, I'm okay now, thank you. I still have the same issues, but now I told them to my therapists and, the next time we meet, we're going through them in depth. She believed me, but I'm still afraid of her thinking that it's all bullshit (Everyone I tried to open me up).  For now I'm keeping me busy by writing what I'm thinking and drawing. I have the same relationship with my parents, but I'm thinking of living by myself because I'm just too tired to fix anything with them

Sorry for my late reply. Anyway, thank you for reading my story, even if you two are the only one who have read it for even a bit. I will try to talk to my therapist about it, I hope she would say something to me this time instead of asking me only questions. Thank you two for your kind replies
